decision.summary: The Federal Reserve decided to hold the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent.

changes.quote: Although swings in net exports have affected the data, recent indicators suggest that economic activity has continued to expand at a solid pace.
changes.explanation: The Committee added a note that net exports caused data swings, while still viewing economic activity as solid.

changes.quote: Uncertainty about the economic outlook has increased further.
changes.explanation: The Fed stepped up its caution regarding where the economy is heading.

changes.quote: The Committee is attentive to the risks to both sides of its dual mandate and judges that the risks of higher unemployment and higher inflation have risen.
changes.explanation: Policymakers formally noted that the risks of both job losses and inflation have increased.

changes.quote: Beginning in April, the Committee will slow the pace of decline of its securities holdings by reducing the monthly redemption cap on Treasury securities from $25 billion to $5 billion.
changes.explanation: The Fed removed language detailing a previous plan to slow the reduction of its bond holdings.

changes.quote: Voting against this action was Christopher J. Waller, who supported no change for the federal funds target range but preferred to continue the current pace of decline in securities holdings.
changes.explanation: The statement removed the record of a past dissent by Christopher J. Waller regarding balance sheet runoff.

tone_quotes.quote: Uncertainty about the economic outlook has increased further.
The Committee is attentive to the risks to both sides of its dual mandate and judges that the risks of higher unemployment and higher inflation have risen.

for_you.text: Card rates should not move on this decision; a $5,000 balance at about 21.37% APR costs about $89.04 a month in interest.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 4.26% and moved -4 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.81% would fall by about $7.99 a month.
Savings yields should stay roughly where they are, since the Fed held rates.
Unemployment was 4.2%, and employers added an average of 72k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 2.3% over the past year (April 2025); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2.7%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 0.1% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved 0 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved 0.43%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved 0.06% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that future choices will depend heavily on incoming economic readings and risks.

citations.detail: In support of its goals, the Committee decided to maintain the target range for the federal funds rate at 4-1/4 to 4-1/2 percent.

validation_notes: Forecast probabilities removed from whats_next (the page shows the live computed forecast).
